notes.title: Winter styling game!
notes.content:
The game has acquired a new look! Now, in the time of winter. in the game, the water froze, and the platform was covered with snow. Replaced by year tree on the Christmas tree. 
[b]Also fixed problem: [/b]
 - Now the sound of sharp mechanical peaks sounds only when the player is near them.

After winter, the game will return to its former summer look! ːsteamhappyː
